product.description: Elizabeth Bennet este intruchiparea perfectăa eroinei tipice pentru Jane Austen:inteligentă, generoasă, sensibilă, incapabilăde gelozie sau de orice alt păcat major. Amputea crede că asta o face o mironosiță insuportabilă,dar adevărul e că Lizzy este o tacirc;nărămodernă și sofisticată, care, la nevoie,știe să dea o replică spirituală și politicoasă,insă mustind de sarcasm. Ocazia i se iveștedin plin cacirc;nd il cunoaște pe arogantul, daronestul burlac Fitzwilliam Darcy, prototipuleroului romantic distant și intens masculin,care o tratează inițial cu superioritate șichiar cu grosolănie. Căci, fără indoială, mizaromanului Macirc;ndrie și prejudecată, intrebareacare a făcut și face generații de cititori săintoarcă filă după filă pacirc;nă in ziua de azi este:vor ajunge Elizabeth și domnul Darcy, in ciudadiferențelor care ii fac aparent incompatibili,să fie impreună? Descoperiți răspunsulin această carte devenită clasică, savuracirc;nd opoveste de dragoste scrisă după toate regulileartei și lăsacirc;ndu-vă fermecați de personajeleei memorabile!

# Pride and Prejudice by Litera

Dive into the timeless world of classic romance with "Pride and Prejudice," a beloved novel that explores themes of love, societal expectations, and personal growth. Published by Litera, this book offers a captivating story filled with memorable characters and unforgettable twists.

## The Story of Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy

Elizabeth Bennet is presented as the perfect heroine for Jane Austen, embodying intelligence, generosity, sensitivity, and an absence of major flaws like jealousy. Though she may initially view others critically, Lizzy is portrayed as modern and sophisticated, possessing a sharp wit and the ability to deliver spiritual and polite replies laced with sarcasm.

Her life takes an unexpected turn when she encounters the arrogant, proud, and aloof Mr. Fitzwilliam Darcy. Initially, he treats her with superiority and condescension. However, as the story unfolds, the reader is drawn into the central question: Will Elizabeth and Mr. Darcy find their way together despite the differences that initially made them seem incompatible?

## A Classic Romance Redefined

This novel recounts a love story written according to all the established rules of the time, allowing you to savor the journey alongside these iconic characters. Discover the enduring appeal of Elizabeth and Darcy as they navigate societal complexities and ultimately find their place in each other's lives. Experience the depth of character and the delightful romance that has made this story a classic.

## Book Details

**Title:** Pride and Prejudice
**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Books
**Price:** 24.99

Explore this classic novel today and add it to your collection.

**Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)**

**Q: Who is the author of Pride and Prejudice?**
A: The novel is associated with Jane Austen, though it is published by Litera in this edition.

**Q: What is the main theme of the book?**
A: The story explores themes of love, societal expectations, pride, prejudice, and personal growth.

**Q: Why is this book considered a classic?**
A: It is celebrated for its memorable characters and its portrayal of a love story written with wit and depth.
